Data coverage & ranking

Candidate pools come from GeckoTerminal’s public new-pool feeds for Solana, Base, and Robinhood Chain. The same token may have several pools; we retain the most liquid returned pool. Retained contracts are refreshed in batches for current liquidity and five-minute flow. Pool creation is not necessarily token launch time.

Starter is a threshold screen based on delayed pool and market snapshots. A pass does not verify a live quote, sellability, contract permissions, or token ownership. Size / liquidity is a screening ratio, not a price-impact estimate. Five-minute flow changes compare overlapping windows. Discover follows launch lifecycle first: New Pairs have measured bonding progress below 80%; Final Stretch has at least 80% progress without confirmed completion; Graduated requires provider-confirmed launchpad completion. Axiom describes Final Stretch as nearing curve completion but does not publish an exact cutoff; 80% is Meme Fast’s threshold. A 100% curve reading without completion stays in Final Stretch. Recovery never changes launch stage. The left column stacks Final Stretch above Fresh Pairs. The middle Observed recovery column independently shows 45m A rebound / B continuation, later recovery, and confirmed graduations under observation. Coins can appear in both their launch-stage section and this recovery view; recovery never removes them from Final Stretch. The right column separates confirmed graduation from volume-only evidence. Missing graduation evidence is listed separately as status unknown; $50,000 in volume cannot prove graduation. Launchpad checks rotate through up to 120 contracts per collection. Recovery labels describe measured historical price patterns, not future success or safety. Explore groups wider cards by context evidence.

Use Investigate for a coin that is no longer in the fresh-pool return. It searches by name, ticker, or contract and hands the exact contract to Inspect.

New candidates must have a pool created within 36 hours, at least $3,000 liquidity, and at least five recent transactions. Once discovered, they remain for five days. The time window uses first discovery for Fresh Pairs and observed completion for recent graduations; the default is six hours, and your chosen window is remembered in this browser. Final Stretch includes qualifying coins across the retained five days regardless of the selected time window. Volume, chain, and drawdown screeners still apply. Choose Newest, 5m volume, 5m activity, or Liquidity explicitly.

Only exact-contract evidence earns the Exact contract label. RSS, name/ticker matches, and general public-web results remain unverified leads. A dash in a 5m field means data is unavailable, not zero. This is not a safety assessment or a trading signal.

Hide drawdowns / rapid rises hides observed deep drawdowns and a caution pattern: at least five fresh five-minute samples in the first hour, price doubling in 15–30 minutes with little pullback, buy-heavy early samples, and liquidity below $50,000. This pattern cannot establish that a rug will occur.
